class.name: HTMLSelection
class.brief_description: The live node selection of an HTML layout.
class.description: Get the selection with [method HTMLLayout.get_selection] or [method HTMLLabel.get_selection]. It holds at most one [HTMLRange]. The anchor can follow the focus in document order. In [HTMLLabel], this selection also controls rendered highlighting and copying.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the selection still belongs to a live layout.

method.name: is_collapsed
method.description: Returns whether the selection is empty or its anchor and focus are the same.

method.name: get_range_count
method.description: Returns zero for an empty selection or one when a live range is attached.

method.name: get_range_at
method.description: Returns the attached range for index zero, or [code]null[/code] when there is no such range.

method.name: get_anchor_offset
method.description: Returns the offset of the selection's anchor.

method.name: get_focus_offset
method.description: Returns the offset of the selection's focus.

method.name: add_range
method.description: Attaches a live range from the same document when the selection is empty.

method.name: collapse
method.description: Moves the anchor and focus to the same boundary. Passing [code]null[/code] clears the selection.

method.name: extend
method.description: Moves the focus while keeping the anchor fixed.

method.name: set_base_and_extent
method.description: Sets both ends of the selection and preserves their direction.

method.name: select_all_children
method.description: Selects the contents of the given node.

method.name: get_text
method.description: Returns the source text in the selection's live range.
